svg.title: How I build: Explicit permissions: Agents only touch what they are allowed to. Observable behavior: Every action leaves a trail you can read. Independent review: Whoever writes the work does not approve it. Honest evaluation: Tests that can fail, reported as they are. Durable context: Memory and handoffs that outlive the session.
